exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Automated Collection
exploitedBy.relevance: An unauthenticated API endpoint allows attackers to programmatically collect monitoring data without credentials.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Indicator Blocking
exploitedBy.relevance: Unauthenticated access to a monitoring API could allow attackers to suppress or block security indicators.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Sniffing
exploitedBy.relevance: Unencrypted telemetry can be intercepted via network sniffing, exposing sensitive monitoring data.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Transmitted Data Manipulation
exploitedBy.relevance: Unencrypted telemetry is vulnerable to in-transit manipulation by adversaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Bypass User Account Control
exploitedBy.relevance: An overprivileged service account may allow attackers to bypass access controls and escalate privileges.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Event Triggered Execution
exploitedBy.relevance: Overprivileged accounts can be abused to establish persistence via event-triggered execution mechanisms.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Default Accounts
exploitedBy.relevance: Hardcoded or default credentials directly correspond to exploitation of default accounts for unauthorized access.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Credentials In Files
exploitedBy.relevance: Hardcoded credentials stored in configuration files are a primary example of credentials in files.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Disable or Modify Tools
exploitedBy.relevance: Unauthorized configuration modification can disable or alter security tools to suppress alerts.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Spoof Security Alerting
exploitedBy.relevance: Unauthorized config changes can be used to spoof or suppress security alerting systems.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
exploitedBy.relevance: Unpatched monitoring agents with known vulnerabilities can be exploited as public-facing applications.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exploitation of Remote Services
exploitedBy.relevance: Unpatched agent software exposes exploitable remote services to adversaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Service Discovery
exploitedBy.relevance: Excessively exposed agent listeners are discoverable via network service scanning.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: System Network Connections Discovery
exploitedBy.relevance: Attackers can enumerate exposed agent listener connections to map network attack surfaces.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Indicator Removal
exploitedBy.relevance: Insufficient logging allows attackers to remove indicators of compromise without detection.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Private Keys
exploitedBy.relevance: Config files may contain private keys stored in plaintext, enabling authentication bypass.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Adversary-in-the-Middle
exploitedBy.relevance: Without mutual TLS, agent-to-collector communication is vulnerable to adversary-in-the-middle attacks.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Steal or Forge Authentication Certificates
exploitedBy.relevance: Absence of mutual TLS exposes certificate-based authentication to theft or forgery.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Temporary Elevated Cloud Access
exploitedBy.relevance: Weak RBAC can allow attackers to gain temporary elevated access to alert management consoles.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Clear Linux or Mac System Logs
exploitedBy.relevance: Log retention misconfigurations mirror the effect of log clearing, removing forensic evidence.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs
exploitedBy.relevance: Misconfigured log rotation may effectively disable or truncate cloud logs, reducing visibility.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Email Hiding Rules
exploitedBy.relevance: Unvalidated input to routing rules can be exploited to create hidden or malicious alert routing similar to email hiding rules.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exfiltration Over Webhook
exploitedBy.relevance: Unvalidated routing rule input could redirect alerts to attacker-controlled webhooks for exfiltration.
